about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We who have celebrated the sacred rites in honor of Holy Mary, our Queen, pray, O Lord, that through the intercession of her in whose honor they have been joyously performed, they may be helpful for our salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
